verdict.rationale: Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows no Atlas API or OpenAPI document: every OpenAPI candidate path probed returned 404. The llms.txt file and Markdown docs that do exist are LLM-readable documentation, an adjacent feature rather than an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
